verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              द्रौणिर्युधिष्ठिरं दृष्ट्वा शैनेयेनाभिरक्षितम् । द्रौपदेयैस्तथा शूरैरभ्यवर्तत हृष्टवत् ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Beholding Yudhishthira protected by Sini's son as well as by the war-like sons of Draupadi, the son of Drona, as if delighted, proceeded against him, scattering goldfeathered arrows, showing various ways of his light-handedness.

verses.sanskrit: किरन्निषुगणान् घोरान् स्वर्णपुङ्खाञ्शिलाशितान् । दर्शयन् विविधान् मार्गान् शिक्षाश्च लघुहस्तवत् ॥२॥
ततः खं पूरयामास शरैर्दिव्यास्त्रमन्त्रितैः । युधिष्ठिरं च समरे परिवार्य महास्त्रवित् ॥३॥
verses.english: Thereupon he filled the sky with arrows of the vigour of celestial weapons. That one, conversant with the use of weapons, withstood Yudhishthira in battle.

verses.sanskrit: द्रौणायनिशरच्छन्नं न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन । बाणभूतमभूत्सर्वमायोधनशिरो महत् ॥४॥
verses.english: When the sky was covered with the arrows of Drona's son nothing could be perceived. The space before the warriors was filled with arrows.

verses.sanskrit: बाणजालं दिवि च्छन्नं स्वर्णजालविभूषितम् । शुशुभे भरतश्रेष्ठ वितानमिव धिष्ठितम् ॥५॥
verses.english: The sky being covered with a net-work of golden arrows it appeared as if a canopy had been spread there.

verses.sanskrit: तेन च्छन्न नभो राजन्बाणजालेन भास्वता । अभ्रच्छायेव सञ्जज्ञे बाणरुद्धे नभस्तले ॥६॥
verses.english: O king, the sky being covered with a network of shining arrows a shadow appeared there like that of clouds.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राश्चर्यमपश्याम बाणभूते तथाविधे । न स्म संपतते भूतं किञ्चिदेवान्तरिक्षगम् ॥७॥
verses.english: When the sky was thus converted into one sheet of arrows it was a wonderful sight to look at. No creature could range in the sky at that time.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिर्यतमानस्तु धर्मराजश्च पाण्डवः । तथेतराणि सैन्यानि न स्म चक्रुः पराक्रमम् ॥८॥
verses.english: Satyaki, although trying his very best, the pious son of Pandu and other warriors, could not display their prowess.

verses.sanskrit: लाघवं द्रोणपुत्रस्य दृष्ट्वा तत्र महारथाः । व्यस्मयन्त महाराज न चैनं प्रत्युदीक्षितुम् ॥९॥
verses.english: Beholding the light-handness of Drona's son, all the mighty car-warriors there, O king, were filled with wonder. All the kings could not look at him, as if shedding lustre of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: शेकुस्ते सर्वराजानस्तपन्तमिव भास्करम् । वध्यमाने ततः सैन्ये द्रौपदेया महारथाः ॥१०॥
verses.english: Thousands of horses and cars were also destroyed by those weapons. The army being thus slaughtered they were possessed by terrible fear. O descendant of Bharata, there was no man amongst the Samsaptakas and Gopalas who could withstand Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिर्धर्मराजश्च पञ्चालाश्चापि संगताः । त्यक्त्वा मृत्युभयं घोरं द्रौणायनिमुपाद्रवन् ॥११॥
verses.english: Thereupon, when their soldiers were being thus slaughtered, the mighty car-warriors, the son of Draupadi, Satyaki, the pious king Yudhishthira and the Panchalas, all united, giving up the dreadful fear of death, rushed towards the son of Drona.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिः सप्तविंशत्या द्रौणिं विद्ध्वा शिलीमुखैः । पुनर्विव्याध नाराचैः सप्तभिः स्वर्णभूषितैः ॥१२॥
verses.english: Piercing the son of Drona with twenty seven arrows he again pierced him with seven gold-plated winged arrows.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिरस्त्रिसप्तत्या प्रतिविंध्यश्च सप्तभिः । श्रुतकर्मा त्रिभिर्बाणैः श्रुतकीर्तिश्च सप्तभिः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira struck him with seventy three arrows and Prativinda with seven, Shrutakarma cut him with three arrows and Shrutakirti with seven. Sutasoma struck him with nine arrows and Satanika with seven. And many other warrior struck him from all sides with a number of shafts.

verses.sanskrit: सुतसोमस्तु नवभिः शतानीकश्च सप्तभिः । अन्ये च बहवः शूरा विव्यधुस्तं समन्ततः ॥१४॥
स तु क्रुद्धस्ततो राजन्नाशीविष इव श्वसन् । सात्यकिं पञ्चविंशत्या प्राविध्यत शिलीमुखैः ॥१५॥
verses.english: Thereupon worked up with rage, O king, he, sighing like a deadly serpent, struck Satyaki with twenty five sharpened arrows.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतकीर्तिं च नवभिः सुतसोमं च पञ्चभिः । अष्टभिः श्रुतकर्माणं प्रतिविंध्यं त्रिभिः शरैः ॥१६॥
verses.english: And he struck Srutakirti with nine arrows and Sutasoma with five; and Prativindhya with three arrows and Srutakarma with eight. And he. struck Raja Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, with five arrows and Satanika with nine. And then he struck other warriors with two shafts each and cut into pieces the bow of Srutakirti with very sharp pointed arrows.

verses.sanskrit: शतानीकं च नवभिर्धर्मपुत्रं च पञ्चभिः । तथेतरांस्ततः शूरान्द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यामताडयत् ॥१७॥
श्रुतकीर्तेस्तथा चापं चिच्छेद निशितैः शरैः । अथान्यद्धनुरादाय श्रुतिकीर्तिर्महारथः ॥१८॥
द्रौणायनिं त्रिभिर्विद्ध्या विव्याधान्यैः शितैः शरैः । ततो द्रौणिर्महाराज शरवर्षेण मारिष ॥१९॥
verses.english: Then, O monarch, O great sire of the Bharata race, the son of Drona covered the Pandava army with showers of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: छादयामास तत् सैन्यं समन्ताद्भरतर्षभ । ततः पुनरमेयात्मा धर्मराजस्य कार्मुकम् ॥२०॥
द्रौणिश्चिच्छेद विहसन्विव्याध च शरैस्त्रिभिः । ततो धर्मसुतो राजन्प्रगृह्यान्यन्महद्धनुः ॥२१॥
verses.english: Just after this the highly spirited son of Drona, casting smiling look upon Yudhishthira, simultaneously cut-off his bow and struck him with three arrows.

verses.sanskrit: द्रौणिं विव्याध सप्तत्या बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत् । सात्यकिस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो द्रौणेः प्रहरतो रणे ॥२२॥
verses.english: Upon that, О king, the son of Dharma took up a very big bow and darted, one after another, seventy shafts, piercing the arms and breast of the son of Drona.

verses.sanskrit: अर्धचन्द्रेण तीक्ष्णेन धनुश्छित्त्वाऽनदद्भृशम् । छिन्नधन्वा ततो द्रौणिः शक्त्या शक्तिमतां वरः ॥२३॥
verses.english: Then Satyaki, filled with anger, roared aloud and broke down in that very battle the bow of that terrible afflicter, Drona's son, with the same-circular and sharp arrow of his own.

verses.sanskrit: सारथिं पातयामास शैनेयस्य रथाद्द्रुतम् । अथान्यद्धनुरादाय द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ॥२४॥
verses.english: When his bow was thus cut-off that hero of heroes, Drona's son, with a dart quickly struck the driver of Satyaki's car down and unseated him from his chariot.

verses.sanskrit: शैनेयं शरवर्षेण च्छादयामास भारत । तस्याश्वाः प्रद्रुताः संख्ये पतिते रथसारथौ ॥२५॥
verses.english: Then, O Bharata, the mighty son of Drona, taking up another bow, covered the son of Sini with quite a shower of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तत्रैव धावन्तः समदृश्यन्त भारत । युधिष्ठिरपुरोगास्तु द्रौणिं शस्त्रभृतां वरम् ॥२६॥
verses.english: Thus, O Bharata, the driver was killed Satyaki's horses were seen to run riot in the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यवर्षन्त वेगेन विसृजन्तः शिताञ्छरान् । आगच्छमानांस्तान्दृष्ट्वा क्रुद्धरूपान्परंतपः ॥२७॥
verses.english: Then the Pandava army commanded by Raja Yudhishthira, rushed furiously towards Drona's son, the foremost of all the wielders of weapons and began to shower sharp shafts upon him.

verses.sanskrit: प्रहसन्प्रतिजग्राह द्रोणपुत्रो महारणे । ततः शरशतज्वालः सेनाकक्षं महारथः ॥२८॥
verses.english: Seeing them thus coming upon him as so many incarnations of anger the great terror of foes, Drona's son, received them all in the terrible battle with a spiteful smile.

verses.sanskrit: द्रौणिर्ददाह समरे कक्षमग्निर्यथा वने । तद्बलं पाण्डुपुत्रस्य द्रोणपुत्रप्रतापितम् ॥२९॥
verses.english: Then the great car-warrior, Drona's son, burnt down, as it were, the Pandava troops in the battle with the flames of his arrows, just as the forest fire burns the dry hays and straws.

verses.sanskrit: चुक्षुभे भरतश्रेष्ठ तिमिनेव नदीमुखम् । दृष्ट्वा चैव महाराज द्रोणपुत्रपराक्रमम् ॥३०॥
verses.english: O foremost of Bharata's race, the Pandava army, thus provoked by the son of Drona, became exceedingly agitated as the water of a river is troubled by a whale.

verses.sanskrit: निहतान्मेनिरे सर्वान्पाण्डून् द्रोणसुतेन वै । युधिष्ठिरस्तु त्वरितो द्रोणशिष्यो महारथः ॥३१॥
verses.english: O Maharaj, seeing the bravery of Drona's son made the people think, as if the Pandava army already were killed.

verses.sanskrit: अब्रवीद्द्रोणपुत्राय राषामर्षसमन्वितः । नैव नाम तव प्रीतिर्नैव नाम कृतज्ञता ॥३२॥
verses.english: Then the great car-warrior Yudhishthira being enraged and filled with revengeful spirit thus addressed the son of Drona in a

verses.sanskrit: यतस्त्वं पुरुषव्याघ्र मामेवाद्य जिघांससि । ब्राह्मणेन तपः कार्यं दानमध्ययनं तथा ॥३३॥
verses.english: O mightiest of men, neither have you any feeling nor do you cherish any sense of gratitude when today you are ready even to slay me.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियेण धनुर्नाम्यं स भवान्ब्राह्मणब्रुवः । मिषतस्ते महाबाहो युधि जेष्यामि कौरवान् ॥३४॥
verses.english: To study and to practise asceticism and charities and the duties of a Brahman and the Kshatriyas only are authorised to use the bow. So it seems that you are a Brahmin in name only.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुष्व समरे कर्म ब्रह्मबन्धुरसि ध्रुवम् । एवमुक्तो महाराज द्रोणपुत्रः स्मयन्निव ॥३५॥
verses.english: However, O you of mighty arms, I am determined upon killing the Kaurava army in the battle just before your eyes. Do your best. I call you a scum of the Brahman race.

verses.sanskrit: युक्तं तत्त्वं च संचिन्त्य नोत्तरं किञ्चिदब्रवीत् । अनुक्त्वा च ततः किञ्चिच्छरवर्षेण पाण्डवम् ॥३६॥
verses.english: Thus addressed, O monarch, the son of Drona smiled bashfully and pondering over what was proper and meet could not give any reply.

verses.sanskrit: छादयामास समरे क्रुद्धोऽन्तक इव प्रजाः । स च्छाद्यमानस्तु तदा द्रोणपुत्रेण मारिष ॥३७॥
verses.english: Getting thus terribly annoyed the son of Drona kept quiet for a while and then began to shower arrows upon the Pandavas like unto the Destroyer himself when bent upon destroying the entire creation.

verses.sanskrit: पार्थोऽपयातः शीघ्रं वै विहाय महतीं चमूम् । अपयाते ततस्तस्मिन् धर्मपुत्रे युधिष्ठिरे ॥३८॥
verses.english: Thus covered, as it were, by the arrows of the son of Drona Pritha's son fled away from the field leaving his large army.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणपुत्रस्ततो राजन्प्रत्यगात्स महामनाः । ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजंस्त्यक्त्वा द्रौणिं महाहवे । प्रययौ तावकं सैन्यं युक्तः क्रूराय कर्मणे ॥३९॥
verses.english: After Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, had thus fled from the field, O king, the highminded son of Drona also left the spot.
